logp.method_description: The distribution coefficients (Do/w) of the radiometal complexes were measured using the “shake-flask” method [4]. Briefly, the HPLC-purified radiometal complex (50 μL, 3.7 MBq, 100 μCi) was mixed with 2.95 mL of PBS buffer (10 mM, pH 7.4) and 3 mL of 1-octanol in a centrifuge tube. The centrifuge tube was vortexed at room temperature for 10 min and then centrifuged for 10 min at 5000 rpm to separate the PBS and 1-octanol layers. Aliquots (500 μL, n = 4) were carefully removed from each layer and counted on the HPGe detector to determine the radioactivity in each layer. The Do/w was calculated by dividing the counts in the 1-octanol by the counts in the aqueous layer and the result expressed as an average of logD7.4 from three different experiments.
